409.description: A batch is already running or a page already exists. Codes: BATCH_ALREADY_RUNNING, PAGE_ALREADY_EXISTS, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. BATCH_ALREADY_RUNNING carries error.details.jobId, the id of the run already in flight, so clients can link straight to it; it is omitted only in the rare case where that job left the active set before the conflict was reported. PAGE_ALREADY_EXISTS carries error.details.pageId and error.details.status for the page that blocked the run.

PageIssueResponse.title: PageIssueResponse
PageIssueResponse.description:
A single structured diagnostic behind ``partialMessage``.

Sourced from the page's persisted ``metadata_json.issues``. Every
``message`` has already passed through ``sanitize_public_diagnostic``,
so it is safe to render directly.

PageNavigationResponse.title: PageNavigationResponse
PageNavigationResponse.description:
Nearest business dates that actually have a page.

Both fields are required but nullable: the client always receives the
keys, and ``null`` means "no such neighbor exists", never "not computed".
Calendar arithmetic on ``businessDate`` is not a valid substitute — the
page table only holds dates a batch produced.
